subject: Procurement onramp + commit envelope clarification — HelioHealth
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira.k@heliohealth.ai>, James Liu <james.liu@heliohealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: procurement thresholds & monthly spend band — HelioHealth

Hi Samira / James —

Thanks again for the demo and the call today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you a procurement-friendly quote: 

Call recap (high level)
- Estimated model usage: ~120M–300M tokens/month based on current pilot mix (mostly chat + embeddings).
- Primary SLO: sub-200ms generation latency for user-facing features; batch workloads are tolerant of higher latency.
- Security: VPC + SOC2 evidence requested (we’ll send SOC2 package once procurement route is clear).

Pricing & budget items we discussed
- Target unit economics you mentioned: wanting to validate ~$15–$20 per 1M tokens; we discussed elasticity based on commit.
- Procurement constraints: you called out a PO threshold that triggers enterprise review. Can you confirm the $/month threshold for issuing a PO?

Asks / next steps from HelioHealth (please):
1) Confirm the expected monthly spend band you want us to use for the official quote (we currently model two bands: 120–180M and 180–300M tokens).
2) Confirm procurement path: preferred (a) credit-card pilot, (b) monthly PO invoicing (<PO threshold), or (c) annual/term PO (if above threshold).
3) Any internal billing contact or procurement portal we should include on the quote?

Attached: a quick estimate (helio_mm_estimate_v2.pdf) and our pricing cheatsheet. I’ll follow up internally to propose a committed offer if you’d prefer predictable unit pricing.

If it helps I can propose three concrete purchase paths (pilot, monthly PO, committed term) with exact $/1M numbers once you confirm the spend band.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

--
Attachment: helio_mm_estimate_v2.pdf (1 page, cost breakdown)
Attachment: redwood_pricing_cheatsheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Samira Kahn <samira.k@heliohealth.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@heliohealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement thresholds & monthly spend band — HelioHealth

Thanks Grace — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed monthly usage: rough expectation is 150M–280M tokens while pilot converts. So your two-band suggestion maps well (we're borderline between the bands).
- Target price: procurement wants us to plan with $18 per 1M tokens for budgeting; happy to revisit if a committed discount is on the table.
- Procurement threshold: our finance team requires a formal procurement review for recurring spend above $5,000/month. Anything below $5k can be handled via standard monthly PO with our vendor portal.

Procurement next steps (from HelioHealth)
1) If the monthly estimate exceeds $5k, we will need a redlined Master Services Agreement and finance approval — that takes ~2–3 weeks.
2) For a pilot under $5k, we can proceed with monthly PO and a shorter vendor onboarding checklist.

James is our procurement lead (cc’d) — he can share the vendor portal URL and the standard PO template.

Samira Kahn
Head of Product — Clinical Apps | HelioHealth
samira.k@heliohealth.ai

--

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement thresholds & monthly spend band — HelioHealth

Quick internal note —

If HelioHealth plans to cross the $5k/month PO threshold, we should surface a committed option asap. Typical play that works:
- 6-month committed band (min commit ≈ $30k total) -> brings unit price to ~$12/1M tokens.
- 12-month committed -> $10–11/1M depending on mix and SLA.

Procurement gating: once they hit $5k/mo we loop Legal (for a shortened MSA + SOW) and Finance for vendor onboarding. That’s ~2–3 week lead time (agree with Samira).

Action items for us:
- Grace: prepare a 6-month committed quote at $12/1M and a month-to-month PO quote at $18/1M. Include a short procurement checklist (docs attached above).
- Marissa: can you flag any redlines we should proactively include for SOC2/KMS language?

—Ben

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira.k@heliohealth.ai>, James Liu <james.liu@heliohealth.ai>, HelioHealth Procurement <procurement@heliohealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement thresholds & monthly spend band — HelioHealth

Hi Samira / James —

Thanks for the quick clarifications — helpful. Per your guidance I’ve attached an updated packet with three purchase paths and exact numbers so procurement can pick the route that matches your PO threshold and timeline: 

1) Pilot (card or monthly PO, < $5k/month)
   - Modeled at 150M tokens/month at $18 per 1M -> ~$2,700/month
   - No long-term commitment; onboarding + SOC2 docs provided.

2) Monthly PO (recurring invoicing, close to threshold)
   - Modeled at 250M tokens/month at $18 per 1M -> ~$4,500/month
   - Fits under $5k threshold; standard vendor onboarding.

3) Committed term (6-month)
   - Modeled at 250M tokens/month but 6-month commit -> unit price $12 per 1M -> ~$3,000/month equivalent; requires shortened MSA + SOW (we’ll pre-fill).

Attached: helio_mm_estimate_v2.pdf (updated), procurement_onramp_checklist.docx, redwood_pricing_cheatsheet.xlsx

Links: HubSpot deal (HubSpot: 87654321), DocuSign quote (https://app.docusign.com/HLH-8765-quote), onboarding Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/hlh-estimates)

Next steps suggested:
- Please confirm which path (1/2/3) you prefer. If 3, we’ll generate a committed quote and route to Legal for a standard MSA (2–3 weeks).
- If 2 or 1, confirm billing contact and PO template URL so we can attach it to the invoice.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute procurement/finance call with James this week if that speeds things up.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
